🌊View from the Couch: The Pacific Gap Opens

Arnold Palacios, Governor of the U.S. territory Northern Mariana Islands, is dead.
Age 69. Sudden “medical incident.” July 24.
You might not know where CNMI is on the map — but the Pentagon sure does.
Right between Guam, the Philippines, and Taiwan.
A key node in the Indo-Pacific command grid.

Palacios wasn’t just managing schools and roads — he was overseeing a forward-deployed governance zone embedded in U.S. civil-military planning.
Now he’s gone…
…right as tensions spike in the South China Sea
…as FEMA & DoD run continuity drills
…and just days after judicial and executive deaths in Russia, Iran, Turkey, and the U.S.
This isn’t a coincidence.
It’s a controlled fire.

The Global Purge has reached the islands.
And the silence in Saipan is deafening.

#WxHistory |
#OTDwx: Typhoon Gaemi '24 (Carina) made landfall in Taiwan with blunt impact. The Philippines & China were greatly impacted as well. The C4 typhoon caused devastating flooding for those 3 areas. In Yonaguni, Japan, a wind gust of 110mph (180kph) was recorded. In 🇹🇼, 20.19in (513mm) of rain was recorded in Luoyuan County. 
Overall, Gaemi killed 152-194 w/ a damage toll up to $4.6B USD. North Korea had reported a death toll into the thousands but that remains disputed. 
For whatever strange reason, both Gaemi & Carina weren't retired & now stay on the list.
